response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_average FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), status_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, 'NULL') as rfistat, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'NULL')), qualifying_statuses AS (SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.avg_modindex, sa.avg_modindex - oa.overall_average as above_average FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.avg_modindex > oa.overall_average), mean_of_qualifying AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as mean_of_qualifying_avgs FROM qualifying_statuses) SELECT qs.rfistat, qs.avg_modindex, qs.above_average, qs.avg_modindex - mq.mean_of_qualifying_avgs as diff_from_mean_of_qualifying FROM qualifying_statuses qs CROSS JOIN mean_of_qualifying mq ORDER BY qs.rfistat;
